name: rulake-stack
description: Killer-path install for ruLake. Bundles rulake-core + rulake-rvdna + rulake-ruqu + rulake-witness + rulake-memory with sensible defaults so a fresh Claude Code session has working witness-anchored retrieval in under 60 seconds. v2.3.0-alpha.4 adds the rulake-memory surface (self-learning agentic memory) plus the /rulake-discover advisory tool.
